labels: Lower in an arc behind your head

text.setup: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands, elbows slightly bent.
cues: Lower the weight in an arc behind your head, keeping the elbow bend fixed.
Go until you feel a stretch through your lats and chest, ribs kept down.
Pull it back up over your chest along the same arc.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows, which turns it into a triceps extension.
Arching the lower back to get more range.
Going too heavy to control at the stretch.

variants.barbell: An EZ bar is kinder to the wrists.
variants.cable: Lie with your head towards a low pulley.
variants.machine: The machine sets the arc — line your shoulders up with its pivot.
